Hey Maya,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached are our most recent usage exports and a first-pass ask from procurement (erosys_current_usage_202802.pdf; erosys_usage_by-service.csv). We're coming up on contract end-of-term June 30 and we'd like to lock in new rates + a two-phase capacity uplift to support a planned pilot in Q3. High level: +20% baseline token throughput, optional dedicated burst pool for weekends, and a 12-month term with an optional 3-month extension.

Can we kick off next steps this week? Priya (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will need a clean doc we can take to legal. My asks for the kickoff call: 
- Confirm what Redwood needs from us (P0: expected throughput numbers and data retention requirements)
- Align on two candidate QBR windows for exec readout
- Get a mutual action plan skeleton (Milestones + owners)

I've attached a draft of proposed terms for context (erosys_proposed_terms_v1.pdf). Available this week on Thursday (3/23) 10:30–11:30 PT or Friday (3/24) 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for you and your team?

Thanks — Taylor

Head of Engineering, Erosys

Taylor — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Looping in Connor (Account Lead) and Marissa (Solutions/Onboarding) so we can align on numbers and runway.

High-level response before we sync:
- We can support a two-phase uplift (baseline + weekend burst pool) but need the expected token-distribution by workload (in particular, what percentage of traffic is batch vs. low-latency interactive). The CSV helps but we may ask for a short sample of time-series token counts by route.
- Term options: we typically present 12-month, 24-month, and a 12-month + 3-month extension. I'll ask legal to prepare a tracked change draft after we agree the commit level.
- QBR windows: Thursday 3/23 10:30–11:30 PT works on my side. Connor/Marissa — can you slot this? If we go ahead, agenda will be: 1) commercial terms & SLA ask, 2) capacity uplift plan & timeline, 3) rollout milestones and owner map, 4) next steps for procurement/legal.

Action items for the kickoff meeting (pre-read please):
- Taylor/Priya: short time-series export of token counts by route for Feb 20–Mar 20 (sample attached would be ideal in 1-hour buckets)
- Connor: prepare committed baseline options (M, L, XL) with unit economics and uplift pricing
- Marissa: draft onboarding/runbook outline for weekend burst pool and expected staffing

I've created a placeholder calendar invite here: https://calendar.redwood.com/slot/erosys-qbr-03-23. If that time is final, we'll convert to an invite with conference details.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
